blocks.text: The Traffic Flow page provides information about the Traffic and DNS Overview. You can access the Traffic Flow page by clicking the View icon () in the Traffic Monitoring's Cloud & Branch Connector table (from the navigation menu, go to Zero Trust Cloud > Dashboard), where you can see the throughput and session count forwarded via Internet & SaaS (ZIA), Private Access (ZPA), Direct, or Log & Control for the selected Cloud or Branch Connector.
The Traffic Overview tab displays the Session Count, Total Traffic, and their corresponding trends.

The Session Count table displays all the session count data for the Cloud or Branch Connector virtual machines (VMs) that are provisioned and deployed in your cloud or branch. The Session Count demonstrates data for:

blocks.item: ZIA: The session count data forwarded through the Internet & SaaS cloud.
ZPA: The session count data forwarded through the Private Access cloud.
Direct: The session count data forwarded directly.
Log & Control GW: The session count data forwarded through the Log and Control gateway.

blocks.text: The Session Count Trend lists the session count across the Internet & SaaS, Private Access, Direct, Log & Control GW, and total services for the Cloud & Branch Connector VMs that are provisioned and deployed in your cloud or branch accounts. You can adjust the time and service filter using the drop-down menus above the graph.
Select a point on the graph to see the value for the specified time period. Click for more info displays the session logs, where you can view real-time log consolidation for each transaction.
The total traffic displays the total inbound and outbound traffic with the corresponding Rx Bytes and Tx Bytes for each of the services:

blocks.item: Rx Bytes: Displays the number of inbound bytes received by the service per second.
Tx Bytes: Displays the number of inbound bytes transmitted by the service per second.
Inbound: Displays the total inbound traffic.

blocks.text: The Traffic Trend lists the inbound and outbound traffic flow across the Internet & SaaS, Private Access, Direct, Log & Control, and total services for the Cloud & Branch Connector VMs that are provisioned and deployed in your cloud or branch. You can adjust the time and service filter using the drop-down menus above the graph.
Click a point on the graph to see the value for the specified time period. Click for more info displays the session logs, where you can view real-time log consolidation for each transaction.
The DNS Overview Tab displays the DNS Monitor and the corresponding DNS Transaction Trends.

The DNS Monitor table displays data about the DNS traffic that is configured by the DNS Filtering Rule. The DNS Monitor demonstrates the total transactions under the following network traffic actions:

blocks.item: Allow: Allows DNS requests and responses that match the rule.
Block: Silently blocks all DNS requests and responses that match the rule.
Resolve by ZPA: Requests the Cloud or Branch Connector to resolve DNS requests using the Private Access IP pool.

blocks.text: The DNS Transaction Trend lists the transactions that are allowed, blocked, or resolved by Private Access for the Cloud & Branch Connector VMs that are provisioned and deployed in your cloud or branch accounts. You can adjust the time and service filter using the drop-down menus above the graph.
Click a point on the graph to see the value for the specified time period. Click for more info displays the session logs, where you can view real-time log consolidation for each transaction.
